To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

a piezoelectric rotary ultrasonic motor can be used to actuate a door lock cylinder, that a design of experiments approach can be used to optimise the design of the stator, and that the rotor position can be detected indirectly by a novel motional admittance based position detection method.
a sensorless PUM based door lock mechanism can be designed and implemented in a cost-effective and secure manner.
a PUM is a suitable actuator for a door lock cylinder and that an indirect sensorless rotor position measurement based on the MAM method is feasible for the application.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the optimisation and integration of the actuation and control electronics of a door lock system.
the design and control of a door lock cylinder actuated by a PUM, featuring a sensorless position detection method based solely on MAM.
the design and optimisation of a PUM for actuating a door lock mechanism, featuring a sensorless position detection method.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

the proposed design and optimisation approach for a door lock actuator based on a piezoelectric rotary ultrasonic motor with a MAM based sensorless position detection method is a promising approach to fulfil the requirements of an electronic door lock actuator.
the proposed design of experiments based design methodology is able to optimise the stator design of a PUM, resulting in an optimal stator with respect to the chosen performance criteria.
the developed door lock cylinder is a viable alternative to existing solutions and is a promising candidate for the future.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
a sensorless PUM-based locking actuator has been successfully developed and optimised.
the developed actuator is a suitable solution for the actuation of electronic door locks.
we have developed a door lock mechanism featuring a sensorless PUM as actuator.
The main takeaway from our work is that
a PUM is an attractive actuator for electronic door lock cylinders, as it is capable of fulfilling all requirements.
a sensorless position detection of the PUM is feasible and that it is possible to design the stator of a PUM for a given application.
a PUM can be used for actuation and position detection of a door lock.
